editorial:
Imagine being so hooked on a true crime story that it starts to take over your whole life. That is exactly what happens to Kelly-Anne. She is obsessed with a scary serial killer named Ludovic Chevalier who is finally on trial. You get to see her world through her eyes as she spends all her time online, digging for secrets and trying to find things the police missed. The vibe is very tense and quiet, making you feel like you are right there with her as she gets deeper into a very dark world of hidden websites and secret payments.

What really makes this work is the acting; the lead actress is great at showing how obsession can change a person. The movie moves a bit slow at first, but the tension builds up until the very end. If you love mysteries that make you feel uneasy, you will love this. It looks amazing, so you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best experience. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a smart move because the colors and lighting are just perfect.
endingExplained: At the end, Kelly-Anne finally gets access to a secret red room site. She pays a huge amount of money to watch a live stream. You find out that the killer is not actually dead or locked away in the way we thought. He is still active and controlling things from the shadows. Kelly-Anne realizes she is not just a viewer anymore, but she has become a part of his sick game.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves true crime podcasts and psychological mysteries.
